A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MergeVLA work. Their complete main text and appendices, including equations, tables and figures, are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original simulation and real-robot experiments, ablations, and appendix investigations of component and block-wise merging.

after.justification: v2 retains original simulation, real-robot and appendix experiments, with revised LIBERO-Plus results.

M1.justification: Section 4.3, Figure 2 and Algorithm 1 move the router's feature/projection source from block l−1 to block l, while retained expert heads still begin at l. Algorithm 1 also explicitly uses task-indexed projections. This locally revises the documented router; masking, expert architecture and merging strategies remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same LIBERO suites, seven LIBERO-Plus perturbations, RoboTwin embodiments and tasks, and three SO-101 manipulation tasks. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 2 removes the single-task OpenVLA-OFT comparator and adds merged VLA-Adapter. The comparator sets in the other experiments remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The stated training budgets, backbone, metrics, demonstration counts, rollout counts and evaluation procedures remain unchanged. LIBERO-Plus still tests LIBERO-trained models without additional finetuning; revised scores do not establish a protocol change.

E4.justification: The LIBERO-Plus robustness comparison replaces OpenVLA-OFT evidence with merged VLA-Adapter evidence across the seven retained shifts. Mask-ratio and routing-subspace ablations, plus the appendix component, depth and mask analyses, remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Trial and rollout reporting is unchanged. Neither version adds training-seed information, repeated-training estimates, confidence intervals, significance tests or other uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Table 2 substantially replaces the reported robustness results: single-task MergeVLA averages 80.0%→72.4%, and merged TSV, TA and TIES average 68.1%→53.5%, 72.0%→61.6% and 72.2%→62.5%. Single-task VLA-Adapter changes from 67.4% to 59.0%; merged VLA-Adapter adds 10.8%, and OpenVLA-OFT's 71.4% row disappears. These are revised reported outcomes, without an explanation establishing their cause. Other result tables and appendix plots retain their results.

T1.justification: The masking and selfishness definitions, SVD construction and projection-norm scoring retain their mathematical form. Routing-source changes are procedural; the k-to-kr dimension correction and softmax notation clarify existing mathematics. No new assumptions, derivations or proofs appear.

C1.justification: The introduction revises headline LIBERO-Plus success from 72.2% to 62.5% and the advertised robustness advantage from 18.7% to 13.4%. The central contributions and broader claims about mergeability, task routing and generalization remain unchanged.

C2.justification: The explanations involving LoRA interference, expert specialization, preserved VLM robustness and value-based routing remain unchanged. Applicability qualifications and future-work boundaries are also retained; the changed comparator-superiority statement reports a finding rather than a new interpretation.

D1.justification: Algorithm 1 revises reproducibility instructions by explicitly indexing projection inputs by task and changing the softmax input from scalar r_m to vector r. Hardware, Table 6 hyperparameters, data-collection details and project-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, novelty framing and 58 cited works are retained. OpenVLA-OFT remains cited elsewhere despite its removal from Table 2; its bibliography entry only loses a page back-reference.

P1.justification: There are localized edits to Sections 4.1 and 4.3 and the robustness comparison narrative. v2 adds acknowledgments and consequently renumbers the appendix sections, without substantially reorganizing the paper.

P2.justification: Figure 2 revises router labels, including block indices and R-to-P projection notation. Table 2 changes row membership and highlighting. Printed page numbers and limited text reflow are added; the overall figure, table and page organization is retained.

improvement.justification: v2 clarifies some routing notation and adds a merged VLA-Adapter comparison, but removes v1's strongest external LIBERO-Plus comparator and replaces substantial robustness results without explaining why. The introduction also retains shared-projection wording despite Algorithm 1's task-indexed specification. These mixed changes leave the net effect on scientific clarity and evidential quality uncertain.
